### Health Analytics with R · Module 05: NLP for Clinical Text
***
**Learning objectives**
- Build a TF-IDF ICD-10 code suggester from clinical text
- Extract structured medication information (drug, dose, route, frequency)
- Implement admission-to-discharge medication reconciliation
- Build a drug-drug interaction checker
- Validate extracted codes against ICD-10 format rules

**Estimated time:** 2.5 hours | **Level:** Advanced | **Libraries:** `stringr`, `dplyr`, `quanteda`

## 2. TF-IDF ICD-10 Code Suggester

```{r}
icd_texts <- paste(icd10_ref$kw, icd10_ref$desc)
toks_icd <- quanteda::tokens(icd_texts, remove_punct = TRUE) |>
  quanteda::tokens_tolower() |>
  quanteda::tokens_ngrams(n = 1:2)
dfm_icd <- quanteda::dfm_tfidf(quanteda::dfm(toks_icd))
if (nfeat(dfm_icd) > 500) {
  keep <- names(quanteda::topfeatures(dfm_icd, n = 500))
  dfm_icd <- quanteda::dfm_select(dfm_icd, pattern = keep)
}
icd_matrix <- as.matrix(dfm_icd)

cosine_rows <- function(vec, mat) {
  nrms <- sqrt(rowSums(mat^2)); nrms[nrms == 0] <- 1
  vn <- sqrt(sum(vec^2)); if (vn == 0) vn <- 1
  as.numeric((mat / nrms) %*% (vec / vn))
}

suggest_icd <- function(text, top_k = 5, threshold = 0.12) {
  toks <- quanteda::tokens(tolower(text), remove_punct = TRUE) |>
    quanteda::tokens_ngrams(n = 1:2)
  d <- quanteda::dfm_match(quanteda::dfm(toks), features = colnames(icd_matrix))
  vec <- as.numeric(as.matrix(d))
  scores <- cosine_rows(vec, icd_matrix)
  top_idx <- order(scores, decreasing = TRUE)[seq_len(top_k)]
  keep <- top_idx[scores[top_idx] >= threshold]
  tibble::tibble(
    code  = icd10_ref$code[keep],
    desc  = icd10_ref$desc[keep],
    score = round(scores[keep], 3)
  )
}

test_notes <- c(
  "Acute decompensated heart failure, BNP 1450, EF 30%, IV furosemide started.",
  "STEMI inferior wall, troponin 2.4, EKG ST elevation, PCI with stent placement.",
  "COPD exacerbation, diffuse wheezes, albuterol nebs, methylprednisolone IV.",
  "Diabetic ketoacidosis, glucose 520, anion gap 24, insulin drip initiated.",
  "Septic shock, lactate 4.2, norepinephrine, vancomycin and meropenem started."
)
cat("ICD-10 Code Suggestions:\n\n")
for (note in test_notes) {
  suggestions <- suggest_icd(note, top_k = 3)
  cat(sprintf("  Note: '%s'\n", substr(note, 1, 60)))
  purrr::pwalk(suggestions, function(code, desc, score) {
    cat(sprintf("    %-8s (%.3f) — %s\n", code, score, desc))
  })
  cat("\n")
}
```

## 3. Structured Medication Extraction

```{r}
drug_list <- sort(c(
  "metoprolol", "carvedilol", "bisoprolol", "atenolol", "labetalol",
  "lisinopril", "enalapril", "ramipril", "losartan", "valsartan", "sacubitril",
  "amlodipine", "nifedipine", "diltiazem", "verapamil",
  "furosemide", "torsemide", "spironolactone", "hydrochlorothiazide",
  "warfarin", "rivaroxaban", "apixaban", "dabigatran", "edoxaban",
  "aspirin", "clopidogrel", "ticagrelor", "prasugrel",
  "heparin", "enoxaparin", "fondaparinux",
  "digoxin", "amiodarone", "sotalol",
  "atorvastatin", "rosuvastatin", "simvastatin", "pravastatin",
  "nitroglycerin", "nitroprusside", "norepinephrine", "vasopressin",
  "vancomycin", "linezolid", "ceftriaxone", "cefazolin", "cefepime",
  "piperacillin-tazobactam", "meropenem", "imipenem", "ertapenem",
  "azithromycin", "clarithromycin", "doxycycline", "ciprofloxacin", "levofloxacin",
  "trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole", "nitrofurantoin",
  "metformin", "glipizide", "glimepiride", "empagliflozin", "dapagliflozin",
  "sitagliptin", "liraglutide", "semaglutide",
  "insulin", "insulin glargine", "insulin detemir", "insulin aspart", "insulin lispro",
  "albuterol", "ipratropium", "tiotropium", "fluticasone", "salmeterol", "budesonide",
  "prednisone", "methylprednisolone", "dexamethasone", "hydrocortisone",
  "omeprazole", "pantoprazole", "lansoprazole", "famotidine",
  "ondansetron", "metoclopramide", "acetaminophen", "ibuprofen", "ketorolac",
  "morphine", "hydromorphone", "fentanyl", "oxycodone", "tramadol",
  "midazolam", "lorazepam", "propofol", "dexmedetomidine",
  "fluconazole", "micafungin", "acyclovir", "levothyroxine"
), decreasing = TRUE, method = "radix")
# Longest names first so "insulin glargine" matches before "insulin"
drug_list <- drug_list[order(nchar(drug_list), decreasing = TRUE)]

dose_unit <- "(?:mg|mcg|g|mL|units?|IU|mEq)"
route_pat <- "(?:PO|IV|IM|SQ|SC|SL|inhaled|topical|PR)"
freq_pat  <- "(?:QD|BID|TID|QID|QAM|QHS|q\\d+h|PRN|once daily|twice daily|daily|weekly)"
drug_pat  <- paste0("\\b(", paste(stringr::str_replace_all(drug_list, "([\\W])", "\\\\\\1"),
                                  collapse = "|"), ")\\b")
med_pat <- paste0(
  drug_pat,
  "(?:[\\s,]+(\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?)\\s*(", dose_unit, "))?",
  "(?:[\\s,]+(", route_pat, "))?",
  "(?:[\\s,]+(", freq_pat, "))?"
)

extract_meds <- function(text) {
  m <- stringr::str_match_all(text, stringr::regex(med_pat, ignore_case = TRUE))[[1]]
  if (nrow(m) == 0) {
    return(tibble::tibble(drug = character(), dose = character(), unit = character(),
                          route = character(), freq = character()))
  }
  out <- tibble::tibble(
    drug  = tolower(m[, 2]),
    dose  = ifelse(is.na(m[, 3]), "", stringr::str_squish(m[, 3])),
    unit  = ifelse(is.na(m[, 4]), "", stringr::str_squish(m[, 4])),
    route = toupper(ifelse(is.na(m[, 5]), "", m[, 5])),
    freq  = toupper(ifelse(is.na(m[, 6]), "", m[, 6]))
  )
  dplyr::distinct(out, drug, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

test_med_notes <- c(
  "Patient is on metoprolol 50 mg PO BID, lisinopril 10 mg PO QD, furosemide 40 mg PO QAM, warfarin 5 mg PO QD.",
  "Started vancomycin 1250 mg IV q12h, piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 g IV q8h, fluconazole 400 mg IV QD.",
  "Insulin glargine 20 units SQ QHS, metformin 1000 mg PO BID, empagliflozin 10 mg PO QD."
)
cat("Structured medication extraction:\n\n")
for (note in test_med_notes) {
  meds <- extract_meds(note)
  cat(sprintf("Note: '%s'\n", substr(note, 1, 65)))
  purrr::pwalk(meds, function(drug, dose, unit, route, freq) {
    cat(sprintf("  %-30s | %-6s %-6s | %-4s | %s\n", drug, dose, unit, route, freq))
  })
  cat("\n")
}
```

## 4. Medication Reconciliation

```{r}
reconcile_medications <- function(admit_text, dc_text) {
  admit_meds <- extract_meds(admit_text)
  dc_meds    <- extract_meds(dc_text)
  admit_set  <- admit_meds$drug
  dc_set     <- dc_meds$drug
  continued    <- sort(intersect(admit_set, dc_set))
  discontinued <- sort(setdiff(admit_set, dc_set))
  new_at_dc    <- sort(setdiff(dc_set, admit_set))
  dose_changed <- continued[purrr::map_lgl(continued, function(d) {
    a <- admit_meds$dose[admit_meds$drug == d]
    b <- dc_meds$dose[dc_meds$drug == d]
    nzchar(a) && nzchar(b) && a != b
  })]
  list(
    continued = continued, discontinued = discontinued,
    new_at_dc = new_at_dc, dose_changed = dose_changed,
    admit_meds = admit_meds, dc_meds = dc_meds
  )
}

admit_meds_text <- paste(
  "metoprolol 50 mg PO BID, lisinopril 10 mg PO QD, furosemide 40 mg PO QAM,",
  "warfarin 5 mg PO QD, atorvastatin 40 mg PO QHS, metformin 1000 mg PO BID, aspirin 81 mg PO QD."
)
dc_meds_text <- paste(
  "metoprolol 25 mg PO BID, lisinopril 10 mg PO QD, furosemide 80 mg PO QAM,",
  "rivaroxaban 20 mg PO QD, atorvastatin 40 mg PO QHS, metformin 1000 mg PO BID,",
  "aspirin 81 mg PO QD, spironolactone 25 mg PO QD, sacubitril 24 mg PO BID."
)

recon <- reconcile_medications(admit_meds_text, dc_meds_text)
cat("MEDICATION RECONCILIATION REPORT\n")
cat(strrep("=", 55), "\n")
cat(sprintf("Admission: %d meds | Discharge: %d meds\n",
            nrow(recon$admit_meds), nrow(recon$dc_meds)))
cat(sprintf("\nContinued (%d):\n", length(recon$continued)))
for (m in recon$continued) cat(sprintf("  checkmark %s\n", m))
cat(sprintf("\nDiscontinued (%d):\n", length(recon$discontinued)))
for (m in recon$discontinued) cat(sprintf("  removed   %s\n", m))
cat(sprintf("\nNew at discharge (%d):\n", length(recon$new_at_dc)))
for (m in recon$new_at_dc) cat(sprintf("  added     %s\n", m))
cat(sprintf("\nDose changed (%d):\n", length(recon$dose_changed)))
for (m in recon$dose_changed) {
  a <- recon$admit_meds[recon$admit_meds$drug == m, ]
  d <- recon$dc_meds[recon$dc_meds$drug == m, ]
  cat(sprintf("  changed   %s: %s %s -> %s %s\n",
              m, a$dose, a$unit, d$dose, d$unit))
}
```

## 5. Drug-Drug Interaction Checker

```{r}
ddi_ref <- tibble::tribble(
  ~drug1,       ~drug2,          ~severity, ~message,
  "warfarin",   "aspirin",       "HIGH", "Increased bleeding risk — monitor INR closely",
  "warfarin",   "ciprofloxacin", "HIGH", "CYP2C9 inhibition — warfarin effect increased",
  "warfarin",   "fluconazole",   "HIGH", "Azole antifungals inhibit warfarin metabolism",
  "digoxin",    "amiodarone",    "HIGH", "Digoxin toxicity — reduce dose by 50%",
  "heparin",    "enoxaparin",    "HIGH", "Concurrent anticoagulants — serious bleeding risk",
  "metformin",  "contrast",      "MOD",  "Hold 48h post-contrast — nephropathy risk",
  "lisinopril", "spironolactone","MOD",  "Hyperkalaemia risk — monitor K+ closely",
  "metoprolol", "diltiazem",     "MOD",  "Additive bradycardia and hypotension",
  "aspirin",    "ibuprofen",     "MOD",  "NSAIDs reduce aspirin cardioprotection"
)

check_ddi <- function(medication_list) {
  med_names <- unique(tolower(medication_list$drug))
  ddi_ref |>
    dplyr::filter(drug1 %in% med_names, drug2 %in% med_names)
}

complex_note <- paste(
  "warfarin 5 mg QD, aspirin 81 mg QD, metformin 500 mg BID,",
  "lisinopril 10 mg QD, spironolactone 25 mg QD, digoxin 0.125 mg QD,",
  "amiodarone 200 mg QD, fluconazole 400 mg IV QD."
)
meds_list <- extract_meds(complex_note)
interactions <- check_ddi(meds_list)
cat(sprintf("Medications: %s\n", paste(meds_list$drug, collapse = ", ")))
cat(sprintf("\nDrug-Drug Interactions (%d flagged):\n\n", nrow(interactions)))
purrr::pwalk(interactions, function(drug1, drug2, severity, message) {
  icon <- if (severity == "HIGH") "HIGH_RISK" else "MOD_RISK"
  cat(sprintf("  [%s] %s + %s\n", icon, drug1, drug2))
  cat(sprintf("           %s\n", message))
})
```

## 6. ICD-10 Code Validation

```{r}
validate_icd <- function(code) {
  code <- toupper(stringr::str_squish(as.character(code)))
  valid <- stringr::str_detect(code, "^[A-Z]\\d{2}(\\.\\d{0,4})?$")
  match <- icd10_ref[icd10_ref$code == code, ]
  list(
    code = code,
    valid_format = valid,
    in_reference = nrow(match) > 0,
    desc = if (nrow(match) > 0) match$desc[1] else "Not in reference"
  )
}

test_codes <- c("I50.9", "E11.10", "A41.9", "INVALID", "I10", "XYZ1",
                "J44.1", "N17.9", "I50.20")
cat("ICD-10 Code Validation:\n\n")
cat(sprintf("%-10s %-10s %-8s %s\n", "Code", "Format", "In Ref", "Description"))
cat(strrep("-", 65), "\n")
for (code in test_codes) {
  r <- validate_icd(code)
  fmt <- if (r$valid_format) "Valid" else "INVALID"
  ref <- if (r$in_reference) "Yes" else "No"
  cat(sprintf("  %-8s %-10s %-8s %s\n", code, fmt, ref, substr(r$desc, 1, 45)))
}
```

## 7. Medication Completeness Audit

```{r}
completeness_audit <- function(text) {
  meds <- extract_meds(text)
  complete   <- meds[nzchar(meds$freq) | nzchar(meds$route), ]
  incomplete <- meds[!nzchar(meds$freq) & !nzchar(meds$route), ]
  cat(sprintf("Total medications : %d\n", nrow(meds)))
  cat(sprintf("Complete records  : %d\n", nrow(complete)))
  cat(sprintf("Incomplete records: %d\n", nrow(incomplete)))
  if (nrow(incomplete) > 0) {
    cat("\nMedications missing route AND frequency:\n")
    purrr::pwalk(incomplete, function(drug, dose, unit, ...) {
      cat(sprintf("  %-25s dose=%s %s -- INCOMPLETE\n", drug, dose, unit))
    })
  }
  incomplete
}

sample <- paste(
  "Patient is on atorvastatin 40 mg, metformin 500 mg PO BID,",
  "aspirin 81 mg, lisinopril 10 mg PO QD, furosemide."
)
completeness_audit(sample)
```

## 8. Knowledge Check
1. ICD-10 suggester gives I50.9 for EF=30%, systolic dysfunction. Is I50.20 more specific? Why does specificity matter for DRG billing?
2. Your medication extractor misses 'Lasix 40 mg' (brand name). How do you fix this?
3. Reconciliation found warfarin discontinued, rivaroxaban added. What clinical monitoring is needed at the transition?
4. DDI checker flags warfarin + aspirin HIGH — but this combination is sometimes intentional. How do you handle this in a real system?
5. Add route-specific dose validation: oral doses should not exceed typical maximum; flag outliers.

```{r}
# Exercise 5 — dose range validation
dose_limits_oral <- list(
  metformin    = c(250, 2550),
  furosemide   = c(20, 600),
  lisinopril   = c(2.5, 40),
  warfarin     = c(1, 15),
  aspirin      = c(81, 325),
  atorvastatin = c(10, 80)
)

validate_doses <- function(text) {
  meds <- extract_meds(text)
  flags <- list()
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(meds))) {
    m <- meds[i, ]
    if (m$drug %in% names(dose_limits_oral) && nzchar(m$dose) &&
        m$route %in% c("PO", "")) {
      dose <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(m$dose))
      if (is.na(dose)) next
      lim <- dose_limits_oral[[m$drug]]
      if (!(lim[1] <= dose && dose <= lim[2])) {
        flags[[length(flags) + 1]] <- tibble::tibble(
          drug = m$drug, dose = dose, unit = m$unit,
          expected = sprintf("%s-%s mg", lim[1], lim[2]),
          flag = if (dose > lim[2]) "ABOVE MAX" else "BELOW MIN"
        )
      }
    }
  }
  if (length(flags) == 0) {
    return(tibble::tibble(drug = character(), dose = numeric(), unit = character(),
                          expected = character(), flag = character()))
  }
  dplyr::bind_rows(flags)
}

test_doses <- paste(
  "metformin 3000 mg PO BID, furosemide 20 mg PO QD,",
  "aspirin 81 mg PO QD, lisinopril 80 mg PO QD, warfarin 5 mg PO QD."
)
flags <- validate_doses(test_doses)
cat(sprintf("Dose validation flags (%d found):\n", nrow(flags)))
purrr::pwalk(flags, function(drug, dose, unit, expected, flag) {
  cat(sprintf("  WARNING: %-15s %s %-5s -- %s (expected %s)\n",
              drug, dose, unit, flag, expected))
})
```
